subject.title: Next Sprint B: model-input validation guardrails

question: Should configured `models.providers.*.models[*].input` accept audio/video as valid metadata, reject them for chat/runtime model inputs, or move them behind a separate explicit capability/override contract?
rationale: Current main intentionally accepts and preserves audio/video metadata, while docs and several runtime paths only define text/image behavior; tightening validation without choosing the contract would break existing config/type behavior.

options.title: Set an explicit capability contract
options.body: Define whether audio/video live in `input`, `mediaInput`, or an override-gated field, then update schema, docs, runtime selection, and tests together.

options.title: Reject unsupported modalities now
options.body: Tighten configured model input validation to text/image and add any needed doctor migration or operator warning for existing audio/video configs.

options.title: Keep broad metadata acceptance
options.body: Document audio/video as accepted metadata and add narrower runtime diagnostics/cross-checks only where a declared capability is actually used for routing.

recommendation.title: Set an explicit capability contract
recommendation.body: Define whether audio/video live in `input`, `mediaInput`, or an override-gated field, then update schema, docs, runtime selection, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: The related history shows broad ownership across provider catalog normalization and media routing, which is where the product/API contract needs to be settled.
